note: Each claim has a counterpart (Wakes, Inclusions, Derivatives, Beam.carries, Table.unit), conditional on RelayCosts, Detector and the rank hypotheses, which [M] supplies from Lemmas E2.6-E2.10. The sentence on convergence along every ultrafilter containing the ordered tails has no standalone statement: [L] refines the order instead.

snippet.text:
def Ranks {L : Register G} (S : Table L) (H : S.RealSpin) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : (freeTable L.grid).RealSpin, ∀ d : ℕ,
    ∃ f : S.Field d ≃ₗ[ℂ] (freeTable L.grid).Field d,
      (∀ x, f (S.conj H d x) = (freeTable L.grid).conj h d (f x)) ∧
      (∀ k x, f (S.mirror H d k x) = (freeTable L.grid).mirror h d k (f x))
